in_marathi.name: Hanmant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hanmant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hanmant is a Sanskrit name that means 'God's gift'. It is derived from the words 'hana' (God) and 'mant' (gift). In Hindu mythology, Hanuman is a revered deity and symbol of strength, devotion, and selflessness. The name Hanmant is often given to boys as a symbol of blessings and divine protection.
